description: Phase 3 verification batch 1/3 — Channel B (CONTRADICTION+UNCERTAIN) keymgr

findings.title: ECC 保护位的生成逻辑缺失：key_state_ecc_words_d 被错误地直连到 key_state_d，而没有经过 SECDED 编码模块。导致每次密钥更新后，内部状态 (key_state_q, key_state_ecc_q) 违反有效 ECC 字假设，ECC 校验逻辑将持续报错，可能引发错误的密钥失效或拒绝服务。
findings.contradiction: ECC 保护位的生成逻辑缺失：key_state_ecc_words_d 被错误地直连到 key_state_d，而没有经过 SECDED 编码模块。导致每次密钥更新后，内部状态 (key_state_q, key_state_ecc_q) 违反有效 ECC 字假设，ECC 校验逻辑将持续报错，可能引发错误的密钥失效或拒绝服务。

evidence.excerpt: The concatenated input {key_state_ecc_q[i][j][k], key_state_q[i][j][k]} is a valid SECDED-encoded codeword for each i,j,k.
key_state_ecc_words_d is continuously assigned to equal key_state_d
On reset, key_state_q is cleared to 0 and key_state_ecc_q is cleared to TotalEccWords repetitions of SecdedInv7264ZeroEcc (all-zero ECC pattern).
For KeyUpdateRandom, each share j of each CDI i writes entropy_i[i] into the bit-slice key_state_d[i][j][cnt[EntropyRndWidth-1:0]].
For KeyUpdateRoot when root_key_valid_q is false, all CDIs set share0 to all-zeros and share1 to all-ones (invalid value).
For KeyUpdateWipe, wipe_key_o asserted, and each share j of each CDI i loaded with {EntropyRounds{entropy_i[j]}}.

findings.title: Assumption 指出 key_chk 缺少赋值逻辑，但 Guarantee 显示 key_chk 在 generate 块中被赋值。这可能是 RTL 分析不完整造成的冲突，也可能反映出设计规约的不一致：消费者认为 key_chk 应为未驱动状态，而生产者实际驱动它，将导致预期的无驱动假设与真实驱动产生多驱动或未初始化行为。
findings.contradiction: Assumption 指出 key_chk 缺少赋值逻辑，但 Guarantee 显示 key_chk 在 generate 块中被赋值。这可能是 RTL 分析不完整造成的冲突，也可能反映出设计规约的不一致：消费者认为 key_chk 应为未驱动状态，而生产者实际驱动它，将导致预期的无驱动假设与真实驱动产生多驱动或未初始化行为。

evidence.excerpt: key_chk signal is declared but not assigned in this region; its intended key share validity checking is absent from the visible logic.
For each share i, key_chk[i] is assigned the result of the valid_chk function applied to key_padded[i].
key_vld_o is driven as the bitwise AND-reduction of key_chk; 1 when all bits of key_chk are 1, else 0.

findings.title: 硬件实现中 data_rand 来源于 LFSR，是一款可预测的伪随机源，而消费者假设其为来自 TRNG 的强随机数据。这可能导致擦除操作中密钥残留泄露或禁用输出时的固定模式可探测，违反安全目标。
findings.contradiction: 硬件实现中 data_rand 来源于 LFSR，是一款可预测的伪随机源，而消费者假设其为来自 TRNG 的强随机数据。这可能导致擦除操作中密钥残留泄露或禁用输出时的固定模式可探测，违反安全目标。

evidence.excerpt: data_rand must deliver strong, independent random data (e.g. from TRNG) to effectively obscure key material during wipe and when data_sw_en is inactive.
data_rand[0] is lfsr[31:0] and data_rand[1] is perm_data(lfsr[63:32], RndCnstRandPerm).
For each i in [KeyMgrStages, 2**StageWidth-1], adv_matrix[i] is assigned {AdvLfsrCopies{data_rand[0]}}.
For each i from KeyMgrStages to 2**StageWidth-1, id_matrix[i] is continuously assigned a vector of IdLfsrCopies bits, all equal to the current data_rand[0].

findings.contradiction: async_fault 被错误地参与 op_fault_err 的计算，导致异步错误（如 FSM 完整性错误）阻止 sw_binding_unlock_o，而根据设计注释异步错误不应影响操作结果，可能造成正常操作被意外封锁。

evidence.excerpt: Comment states 'async errors have nothing to do with the operation and thus should not impact operation results', but async_fault is included in op_fault_err, which blocks sw_binding_unlock_o.

async_fault_d[AsyncFaultFsmChk] is the OR of state_change_err_i and op_state_cmd_err_i.

findings.contradiction: 硬件在 state_q 进入非法编码时立即通过 working_state_o 输出 StInvalid 错误状态，导致上层依赖静默恢复的错误处理机制无法正常工作，错误信息被意外泄露，可能引发虚假的错误中断或不安全的状态机行为。

findings.contradiction: LFSR 重新播种控制器将 entropy_i 硬连线到 0，而 keymgr_kmac_if 的 decoy 输出路径要求该信号提供随机掩码。结果诱饵输出将变为恒定模式，丧失侧信道防护能力，可能泄露密钥处理状态。
